main_text.p: batur Sacrificia, Ablutiones, & Sacramenta propria;itémque distinctiones Personarum, Locorum, Temporum, & Ciborum; instituta, ut Christum, & expiationem ac reconciliationem Sacrificio ipsius peragendam,& sanctificationem ac salvationem populi ipsius, præfigurarent; Statum Ecclesiæ quasi infantilem duriusculè exercerent: verùm interim Euangelium promissionis confirmarent, ac Fidem eorum in Christum dirigerent, usquè ad tempora correctionis ; Gal. iv, 1 -- 4. Col. ii, 16, 17. Hebr. ix, 9, 10. x, 1. Dan. ix, 27. Adeóque Instituta illa formaliter conssiderata, sub ratione signorum & typorum, Christum ejusque Officia & Beneficia indicantium, ad Euangelium pertinent. Verùm si actûs illi materialiter spectentur, ut sic observandi ex necessitate Præcepti Divini, istos homines ac tantisper obligantis,adeò ut isto tempore sine damnabili inobedientiâ prætermitti non possent; hoc respectû ad Legem pertinent; & tùm ad secundum, tùm ad quartum Decalogi Præceptum reducenda videntur, tanquàm additamenta, vel amplia-

page.notes: Printed text has a faded grey smudge across the middle lines; the Google digitiser watermark at bottom right is omitted. Some words are doubtful due to the scan: "Christum" (printed "Christum" with long s rendered as s), "præfigurarent" and "reconciliationem" read with confidence. The "Christum" after "ut" appears to be "Christum" in the original; catchword is absent.
